description: This file contains implementation code for listing objects in a Git repository. It defines structures and functions for traversing commits, trees, blobs, and tags, applies filters, and manages object inclusion and exclusion criteria during traversal.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Callback function to display a commit during traversal, if a show_commit handler is provided.

methods.name: void show_object(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct object * object,const char * name)
methods.description: Callback function to display an object (blob, tree, tag) during traversal, if a show_object handler is provided.

methods.name: void process_blob(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a blob object, applying filters and displaying it if relevant.

methods.name: void process_tree(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tree object and its contents, respecting depth limits and filters.

methods.name: void process_tree_contents(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Iterates through tree entries and processes blobs and subtrees.

methods.name: void process_tag(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tag * tag,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tag object, applying filters and optionally displaying it.

methods.name: void mark_edge_parents_uninteresting(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge)
methods.description: Marks parent commits and associated trees as uninteresting if their child commit is uninteresting.

methods.name: void add_edge_parents(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Adds parent commits' trees to a set for traversal, marking them as uninteresting if necessary.

methods.name: void mark_edges_uninteresting(struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,int sparse)
methods.description: Marks commit edges and trees as uninteresting based on the specified flags and options.

methods.name: void add_pending_tree(struct rev_info * revs,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the list of objects pending traversal.

methods.name: void traverse_non_commits(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes all pending non-commit objects (trees, blobs, tags) in the traversal.

methods.name: void do_traverse(struct traversal_context * ctx)
methods.description: Performs the main traversal loop over commits, processing associated trees, blobs, tags, and handling filters.

methods.name: void traverse_commit_list_filtered(struct rev_info * revs,show_commit_fn show_commit,show_object_fn show_object,void * show_data,struct oidset * omitted)
methods.description: Public API function initiating the traversal over a list of commits with filtering and display callbacks.
